aeIpcProcess.wait.raw_desc:

**`wait(interval: float = 30, timeout: float = 1000000) -> None`**

Suspends the parent process until the sub process terminates.

Parameters
**interval**float, message interval, default 30 seconds.
**timeout**float, max wait time, default 1000000 seconds.

Examples

    >>> import pyAether as pyScript
    >>> p = pyScript.aeIpcBeginProcess('sleep 30')
    >>> p.wait(3, 35)
